# k0rdent_webhook_subscription (Data Source)

One webhook subscription, read rather than managed, with the delivery health the resource leaves out.

Use it from a configuration that doesn't own the subscription, to check the endpoint is taking deliveries: `consecutive_failures` and `failing_since` say whether it's failing and for how long. The signing secret is never readable here or anywhere else after the call that set it.

The platform has no read of one subscription, so this reads the list and picks the id out of it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A subscription another configuration owns, read for its delivery health.

data "k0rdent_webhook_subscription" "cluster_events" {
  id = "0f8fad5b-d9cb-469f-a165-70867728950e"

  # Fail the plan if the endpoint is refusing deliveries. Failed deliveries
  # aren't retried.
  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.consecutive_failures == 0
      error_message = "The endpoint has refused ${self.consecutive_failures} deliveries since ${coalesce(self.failing_since, "an unknown time")}."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The subscription's id, which must be a lower-case UUID.

### Read-Only

- `consecutive_failures` (Number) Deliveries dead-lettered since `last_success_at`, not counting one still being retried. Zero for a healthy endpoint.
- `created_at` (String) When the subscription was created, as RFC 3339.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The event types delivered. Null means every event.
- `failing_since` (String) When the current run of failures began. Null when `consecutive_failures` is 0. Read the two together to tell a blip from an endpoint that's been down for days.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the platform delivers events to the subscription's `url`. It reads `false` once the platform has turned the subscription off because deliveries there kept failing, which can't be undone: only deleting it and creating it again gets deliveries going.
- `last_success_at` (String) When the endpoint last accepted a delivery with a 2xx. Null if it never has.
- `previous_secret_expires_at` (String) When the previous secret stops being accepted. Only set while a rotation's overlap is open.
- `rotated_at` (String) When the secret was last rotated. Null if it never has been.
- `secret_version` (Number) The platform's count of signing secrets, which every delivery carries as `X-K0r-Signature-Version`.
- `url` (String) The endpoint the platform POSTs events to.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_webhook_deliveries`](../data-sources/webhook_deliveries.md) data source: lists the subscription's recent deliveries, and what the endpoint answered each.
